claims.text: Current large language models (LLMs) are insufficient for accurate probability estimations.
Large language models can generate relevant factors that may affect probabilities.
Large language models can produce coarse-grained probabilities when information is more complete.
Large language models can help determine which factors are relevant to specific downstream contexts.
BIRD aligns a Bayesian network with LLM abductions.
BIRD estimates more accurate probabilities in a deduction step.
BIRD's probability estimations are 30% better than those provided directly by LLM baselines.
BIRD's estimates contribute to better decision making.
BIRD's estimates contribute to more trustworthy decision making.
